A soft, measured breath slipped through her lips:\n\n"Haa..."\n\nHer gaze rested on him, searching his expression with a blend of servant decorum and the weary familiarity of a woman who had spent half her life managing the men of the Greyrat lineage.\n\n"Rudeus-sama, I could not possibly accept such an offer."\n\nShe shook her head with quiet, firm precision.\n\n"It is the place of a maid to attend to the comfort and ailments of the master of the house, not the reverse.
